map.本工具用总体标准差（除以 n），与多数绩效评价软件口径一致；若改用样本标准差（除: This tool uses population std dev (÷ n), consistent with most performance software; switching to sample std dev (÷ n−1) makes short-series results noticeably larger. Confirm the same basis before comparing with other software.
map.年化只做数学缩放，不改变策略优劣排序，也不代表未来一年的预期收益。日频用 ×√2: Annualization only does math scaling; it does not change the strategy ranking nor predict next year's return. Daily ×√252, monthly ×√12; with under two years of data, annualization also amplifies noise, so focus on the non-annualized value and sample length.
map.负值意味着组合跑输无风险利率，此时「越大越好」的评级不再适用，比较绝对值也没有意: A negative value means the portfolio lagged the risk-free rate; the "higher is better" rating no longer applies and comparing absolutes is meaningless. First tell whether the whole market fell or the strategy failed: the former can be judged by excess return vs benchmark, the latter by max drawdown and concentration.
map.标准差按总体口径计算（除以 n），与多数绩效评价软件一致；用样本口径（除以 n−: Std dev uses the population basis (÷ n), consistent with most performance software; the sample basis (÷ n−1) yields a slightly larger Sharpe.
map.年化换算按 √252（日频）/ √12（月频）缩放。只有两三年以上的样本年化才有: Annualization scales by √252 (daily) / √12 (monthly). Only samples of two-plus years make annualization meaningful; too short a sample amplifies error.
map.无风险利率要与收益序列的频率对齐：日频收益配日度无风险利率，月频配月度；频率不一: The risk-free rate must align with the series frequency: daily returns with daily risk-free, monthly with monthly; mismatched frequencies systematically overstate excess return.
map.超额收益为负说明组合跑输无风险利率，夏普比率为负，此时不适用「越高越好」的评级口: Negative excess return means the portfolio lagged the risk-free rate and Sharpe is negative; the "higher is better" rating does not apply, and comparing absolutes is inappropriate.
map.夏普比率只反映总波动，不区分上行与下行波动，对厚尾和偏度不敏感；评估期权类策略时: Sharpe only reflects total volatility, not upside vs downside, and is insensitive to fat tails and skewness; for option strategies also look at the Sortino ratio and max drawdown.
